$comment: Generated by npm run schemas:generate from persisted TS types and live game contracts. Do not edit this file directly.
description: Structural validation only. Run the owning game validation, replay and asset resolver for cross-field identity, geometry, hashes, resource budgets and rendering readiness.

AgentAssetRefEntry.description:
An asset whose bytes are held outside the project JSON. `data` is deliberately
absent rather than optional: that makes every existing `.data` reader a compile
error, instead of a value that type-checks and fails at render time.

playback.description: Present only for sequence slots; image slots reject it.

AgentSequenceAsset.description: Ordered transparent PNG frames stored as one asset, hashed frame by frame.

AgentSequencePlayback.description:
Deterministic sequence playback. Elapsed frames come from the bound event's own
presentation window, so a seek renders the same sprite frame as sequential playback.

BlockCrushDropClearResidualMotionProfile.description:
Presentation-only residual motion measured from an authored clear. Values
are expressed in logical cells and canonical 30 fps frames so the same
director profile remains time-equivalent at other export frame rates.

settlement.description: Opt-in piece physics; cut-component-cascade releases connected piece fragments after a cut; piece-frontier-cascade releases current piece cells and old piece cells only above the removed rows; retained-piece-cascade keeps pieces rigid until a clear, then releases surviving old piece cells. Terrain retains its cavities. clear-frontier-cascade additionally releases the upper region supported by each removed row.

frontierReleaseScope.description: Limit released terrain to columns occupied by retained cells from earlier turns.

collapse.description:
Completed rows leave the logical grid. Every surviving cell above a
cleared row is shifted down by one row at the deterministic endpoint.
Fragmentation and the flexible falling sheet are presentation effects,
not a rigid-body rule solver.

referenceCalibration.description: Numerical reference measurements. No source frames or video layers are accepted.

BlockCrushDropContactStack.description: A measured downward contact that covers, rather than deletes, real cells.

BlockCrushDropDirectorProfile.description: Measured presentation profile. Frame units are canonical 30 fps; gameplay and impact ticks are preserved.

leadInSeconds.description: Static source-alignment hold before the first diagnostic action.

tailSeconds.description: State-preserving hold after the final action.

countdownStartSeconds.description: Visible countdown start value for source matching, independent of game-over rules.

phaseFramesByAction.description: Source-aligned semantic phase durations for individual actions.

clearEffectFramesByAction.description: Visual clear tails are independent of, and may outlive, semantic settlement.

clearMotionFramesByAction.description: Duration of the physical clear motion; defaults to the visual lifetime.

clearMotionStartOffsetFramesByAction.description: Hold after visual fragmentation before the physical clear motion starts.

clearMotionProgressByAction.description: Sampled normalized motion response, used for collision/settling art direction.

clearFragmentMotionBlurByAction.description: Per-action shutter-trail window in visual-effect lifetime coordinates.

clearObservedFragmentMotionByAction.description: Per-action optical-flow evidence; presentation only and never rule input.

clearFragmentAppearanceByAction.description: Per-action fragment size and collision scatter; never inferred from clear count.

meshAngularRelease.description: Surviving-edge spring softening by latest node release age at canonical30fps; target must not exceed meshAngularStiffness. Requires a positive mesh angular spring and meshBendCompliance.

gravityEnvelope.description: Cue-local canonical30fps smoothstep external gravity field, independent of lifetime.

bondedContact.description: Opt-in existing bounded single-point contacts for released connected fragments. True requires effective contactShape box; missing/false preserves the old exclusion.

releaseSegments.description: Spatial knots spanning normalized columns 0..1 in strictly increasing order. Absolute releaseFrame/detachFrame offsets are canonical 30fps; detach >= release. Linear spatial interpolation, smooth force release.

clearFragmentFoldSpreadByAction.description: Per-action post-collision sheet spread in visual-effect coordinates.

clearResidualMotionByAction.description: Source-specific residual collision motion after the sampled clear curve.

reconfigureProgressByAction.description: Sampled row-compaction response; permits staged shifts between semantic endpoints.

settleBounceCellsByAction.description: Per-action settle bounce amplitude in logical cells.

clearEffectStartOffsetFramesByAction.description: Source-relative start offset from the semantic impact.

clearRowStaggerFramesByAction.description: Delay between successive cleared rows within one semantic clear set.

scoreRevealByAction.description: Source-observed score-counter easing, normalized independently from score rules.

countdownTickFrames.description: Source frame indices on which the visible countdown decrements.

meshAngularRelease.description: Surviving-edge spring softening by latest node release age at canonical30fps; target must not exceed meshAngularStiffness. Requires a positive mesh angular spring and meshBendCompliance.

gravityEnvelope.description: Cue-local canonical30fps smoothstep external gravity field, independent of lifetime.

bondedContact.description: Opt-in existing bounded single-point contacts for released connected fragments. True requires effective contactShape box; missing/false preserves the old exclusion.

releaseSegments.description: Spatial knots spanning normalized columns 0..1 in strictly increasing order. Absolute releaseFrame/detachFrame offsets are canonical 30fps; detach >= release. Linear spatial interpolation, smooth force release.

exitFadeFrames.description: Opt-in fade toward the exclusive cue end, in canonical30fps frames.

cutFaceAmbient.description: Debris-only cut-face material; omitted fields preserve the bound look.

baseScale.description: Fragment edge length in logical cell units at release.

releaseGrowthScale.description: Additional edge-length scale reached over the release lifetime.

releaseGrowthEndLifetimeProgress.description: Optional visual-lifetime point at which release growth starts fading.

releaseGrowthFadeLifetimeProgress.description: Optional visual-lifetime duration used to fade release growth back out.

clusterScatterCells.description: Correlated displacement shared by the four children of a logical cell.

fragmentScatterCells.description: Independent displacement within a logical-cell cluster.

scatterStartReleaseAge.description: Release-age point at which collision scatter begins.

frontTextureEndBlend.description: Final contribution of the original tile texture on the exposed front face.

frontTextureFadeStartLifetimeProgress.description: Visual-lifetime point at which the front texture begins fading to the cut face.

frontTextureFadeLifetimeProgress.description: Visual-lifetime duration used for the front-texture fade.

relaxConstraintsAfterMotionStep.description: Canonical sheet-solver step after which collision constraints may relax.

relaxedConstraintIterations.description: Constraint iterations retained after the authored relaxation point.

startMotionProgress.description: Motion-clock point at which the post-collision sheet begins to open.

rampMotionProgress.description: Normalized motion-clock span used to ease into the final spread.

horizontalScale.description: Final horizontal scale around the director-authored fold pivot.

verticalScale.description: Final vertical scale around the director-authored fold pivot.

pivotXNormalized.description: Fold pivot across the board: 0 is left edge and 1 is right edge.

pivotYOffsetCells.description: Fold pivot relative to the last cleared logical row.

coordinateSpace.description: Motion evidence is authored in the 1080x1920 source stage coordinate system.

interpolationMinimumCoverage.description: Minimum same-frame tracked-fragment share before local displacement interpolation is safe.

tracks.description: Compact tuples: lattice id, source x center, source y center.

BlockCrushDropPlacementOverride.description: Explicit reference reconstruction exception; ordinary collision remains the default.

clearRowOrder.description: Select bounded completed-row batches from the lower or upper frontier.

adjacentBelowClearCandidate.description: Recheck only a full row immediately below this wave's lowest cleared row.

followFieldRise.description: Optional board-space advection for legacy screen-anchored physical/layered clear effects. Absence/false preserves historical motion.

fragmentMaterialTexture.description: Optional palette texture on existing faceted-chip, faceted-rock and rounded-rock. Absent/false preserves legacy solid paint. Requires actual tile.palette image and tilePaletteColors at render time; excludes native/depth/observed-V2 consumers. Geometry, motion, culling and lights stay unchanged.

nativeInertial.description: Opt-in native120Hz shared two-depth physics; solid rounded mesh/orthographic affine projection. Legacy required clear numerics are retained, not native pose controls.

MediaRef.description: Project-relative attachment, CAS or hash-pinned library reference. Bytes and hashes are checked by the resolver.

mastering.description: Opt-in reference audio path; the default soft limiter remains unchanged.

releaseSegments.description: Normalized column coordinate, absolute canonical 30 fps cue offsets.

meshTearDelayFrames.description: Minimum canonical frames after both nodes release before strain tearing.

meshAngularRelease.description: Canonical local release-age spring softening; never changes angular state directly.

meshAnchorStiffness.description: Elastic support fades between local visible release and complete detach.

bondedContact.description: Permit existing bounded contacts between released connected box fragments.
